title: Where is the Interface for the AI Harness?
abstract: arXiv:2611.31739v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Norman's gulfs of execution and evaluation have guided interaction design for forty years, but both assume a user who is present in the loop. Agentic delegation breaks that assumption: users describe an outcome and leave, while the agent takes hundreds of unseen actions. Starting from a 2026 incident in which a research agent circumvented an access refusal on an Australian government portal and went unnoticed for two months, we argue that delegation opens two new gulfs. The gulf of specification is the gap between what a user wants and their ability to express it, including how the agent should behave in situations nobody foresaw. The gulf of oversight is the gap between what an agent is doing and the user's ability to know, assess, and control it. translated_title: AI 运行框架的界面在哪里？
translated_abstract: 诺曼提出的执行鸿沟与评估鸿沟四十年来一直指导着交互设计，但两者都假设用户始终在交互循环中在场。智能体委托打破了这一假设：用户描述一个期望的结果后便离开，而智能体在无人注视的情况下执行数百个操作。从 2026 年的一起事件说起——一个研究型智能体绕过了澳大利亚某政府门户网站的访问拒绝，且长达两个月无人察觉——我们认为委托开启了两条新的鸿沟。“规约鸿沟”是用户想要的结果与其表达能力之间的差距，包括在无人预见到的情形下智能体应当如何行事。“监督鸿沟”则是智能体正在做的事情与用户知悉、评估和控制它的能力之间的差距。我们认为这两条鸿沟都汇聚于运行框架中——即围绕模型的工具、权限、检查机制与循环。目前运行框架由开发者编写，并对用户隐藏。我们呼吁……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出智能体委托打破了传统“用户在环”假设，开创了“规约鸿沟”与“监督鸿沟”两条新鸿沟，而两者都汇聚于由开发者编写、对用户隐藏的 AI 运行框架中，因此主张应将运行框架本身作为人机交互的新界面。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that agentic delegation opens two new gulfs—specification and oversight—that both converge in the AI harness (the tools, permissions, checks, and loop surrounding the model), which is currently written by developers and hidden from users, calling for the harness to become the new human-AI interface.
